reviews.text:
Micah of Paradise Screens is an incredible young man! He’s warm, friendly, knowledgeable, responsive and most of all a MAGICIAN at his work! It’s his passion and my photos will tell the story my words can’t!

He made my dream come true with this patio enclosure - I’m still speechless!!!

The additional concrete was added when I moved inn bc of flooding! He was able to enclose it all and open my space even bigger!!

I’m in LOVE! Highly recommend Micah for your work!

It was smooth from start to finish!!!
reviews.author: Nicole Delgado

reviews.text:
Paradise Screens is a life changer!  Micah and his team did outstanding work on our patio by building the most beautiful Lanai ever!  He has transformed our home into one that we can truly enjoy for a long time.  Our Lanai has added an additional living space that we can absolutely love!

Micah has definitely exceeded our expectations and continues to do so even after the work was completed. I requested an additional roller screen to protect against the sun during the hottest point of the day and he did not hesitate to come over to complete the work (at no charge).  Now, we can enjoy the sunrise/sunset on a daily basis.  We can sit outside, watch TV and eat without flies and mosquitoes infesting the area.  We can have great times for years to come with our family and friends!  It is a must that you chose Paradise Screens! You will not regret it.  Thanks so much Micah!!!
reviews.author: Dana Walker

reviews.text: Great company and nothing but 100% quality products and installation.  Had 3 motorized screens installed on my patio and they turn out great.  Micah and his team are fabulous to work with, and I would highly recommend if in the market for patio screens.
reviews.author: Greg Manuel

reviews.text: I could not be happier with Paradise screens, Micah went above and beyond in every way from scheduling, design, construction and then cleanup they exceeded all of our expectations! They are very professional, knowledgeable and hard working. It’s always a little nerve wracking hiring a new contractor but I can tell you that you have nothing to worry about with these guys!
reviews.author: Cody Klapper

reviews.text: I would absolutely recommend Micah and Paradise Screens to any and everybody that is desiring to turn their space into a bug free, much more enjoyable paradise. I'll first start with his presentation, I interviewed at least 4 different companies but none presented themselves as professionally as he did. I, without the need to see any of his work in person, felt that he would do a great job and did he ever!!! His work is even better than I hoped it would be! His prices are very competitive but his workmanship is top notch! He is not 5 star because I'm being nice, he's 5 star because HE JUST IS!!

reviews.text: Micah installed a screen on my patio. He did a great job. I am highly recomand him. I love my patio ,no more bugs.

reviews.text: Micah was seamless to work with. He was very prompt with all his responses. reviews.text: Look no further. Micah and this business are perfection. We had him "blind" half of our lanai and knew right away we wanted him to complete the other half. reviews.text: So happy with how my motorized screens turned out! I was tired of the thin magnetic closing screens that would only last about a year. The material would get brittle and my dog kept running through the screens and tearing them. These are heavy duty and seal so the bugs will stay out. The paint for the frame rails and motor were a perfect match and blend right into our trim. Micah was great to work with and made the whole process quick and easy. Definitely recommend these guys and will use them again for future projects.
reviews.author: Doug Anderson

reviews.text: I highly recommend Paradise Screens. They did an excellent job installing a privacy wall on my back porch. Very dependable and professional. Micah was very responsive to our questions and the job was completed in a timely manner. Locally and family owned business.
reviews.author: Donna Moore

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Paradise Screens. They are prompt, professional, and very reasonably priced. I had a few rooms that the summer heat was making these rooms uncomfortable, even with air conditioning. They responded timely, helped choose a great screen color for my exterior home and turn around time was great. I’m extremely happy with my purchase and definitely recommend this company for a great customer experience and superior quality product. My rooms are much cooler!
reviews.author: Susan Shockey

reviews.text: Paradise Screens did a great job re-screening my large screened porch. Micah communicated well throughout the entire process and the price was very reasonable.  I would definitely recommend this company.
reviews.author: S H

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Micah, he came out to fix my motorized screen. From first contact over the phone to him coming out and taking care of my patio, the communication was excellent—quick responses, clear updates, and punctual arrival. The service itself was top-notch—everything was handled efficiently and with care. Highly recommend for anyone needing reliable and professional screen repair!
reviews.author: Lorenzo Cruz

reviews.text: I waited a year to give my review, partly because we had some things that needed to be fixed and I wanted to see how that went. I will now say Micah and his team are top notch customer service! Micah is extremely knowledgeable on his products and they are very responsive in their customer service! Extremely happy with our screen!
reviews.author: Robyn Fox

reviews.text:
Micah with Paradise Screen came to our home today and did an outstanding job enclosing our patio with a screen. From start to finish, he was professional, friendly, and delivered exactly what he promised. The quality of his workmanship is phenomenal — everything looks clean, sturdy, and well-finished. My wife and I are extremely happy with the results!

Thanks to his work, our kids can now play in the patio area without us worrying about bugs, and it’s quickly become one of our favorite parts of the house. It’s rare to find someone who takes this much pride in their work and follows through with such care and attention to detail.

We’re beyond satisfied and highly recommend Paradise Screen to anyone looking to improve their outdoor space!
reviews.author: Hamed Tavakoli

reviews.text: Paradise Screens did a great job screening in our patio. We will definitely use them again for any of our screen needs and 100% recommend!

reviews.text: Micah came out and put a permanent screen up on our patio. Not only was it hot but extremely windy. I highly recommend Paradise Screens.

reviews.text:
If you're like my wife and me, you value the quiet moments of peace watching the beautiful Texas sunset in awe of God's creation. Inside the screened-in porch Micah and the team at Paradise Screens built for us, we can do this with an impenetrable barrier between us and the critters and crawlies!

As part of our new construction, one of our most prized features is our stunning screened-in porch. Our builder searched for months to find a reliable company to handle the screens but had no luck. After doing extensive research, my wife found Paradise Screens and decided to give them a call. From the very first conversation with Micah, which was overwhelmingly enjoyable, we knew we were in good hands. Micah was both friendly and professional, making the entire process a breeze.

Micah came out and gave us an estimate that was not only within our budget but also within the timeline we needed to make our move-in date. While our builder faced challenges with this part of the project, Micah swooped in and saved the day. He and his team did an incredible job, exceeding our extremely high expectations.

Micah helped transform our house into a dream home, and I give him my highest possible recommendation. His work ethic and integrity are unmatched, and he truly delivers on what he promises.

Paradise Screens is a game-changer. They don’t just meet expectations; they redefine them. Don't miss the chance to work with the best!
reviews.author: Martin Richard

reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this company. I’ve dealt with a few other companies that do the motorized screens Nowhere near the quality or the service of these guys. He gave me a price that I could work with. He showed up when he said he would. And he got the job done. My customer and I were extremely happy with the outcome. I spoke with two other companies and they said my 16 foot opening would have to have a post in the middle. These guys made it happen without the post.

reviews.text: Pricing amazing, time to complete the job amazing, quality of work amazing. These guy went above and beyond what I was expecting. Great job.

reviews.text: Overall great experience. Micah was quick to come out initially, quick with a price and once the screen came in, he was here the next day. Great work ethic

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Micah. We will hire him again for our next job.  Thanks so much, Micah, for your professionalism.

reviews.text: I was a little skeptical at first when speaking with Micah. We talked on the phone and he ensured me that by me taking the measurements myself it would make the whole process faster. Definitely knew what he was doing. For anyone around looking to have a screened in porch, I would 100% recommend paradise screens.
reviews.author: Brandon Wilkerson

reviews.text: 10/10 would recommend. Got a quick response and worked with my busy schedule. Only meet a few times in person but the end result was beyond perfection. Will not regret working with Micah, he’s the right one for any job.

reviews.text: I can’t praise Micah enough. For a year now, he’s been coming to my home once a month for maintenance, repairs and installs. He does ‘everything’! He ask me how I want something done but now I just ask him to do it as he would in his home, it’s always better than how I would do it if I were able. Always faithful, trustworthy and more than fair. I’m retired and just can’t do the things I use to. Micah is my arms and legs.

reviews.text: Support local small businesses- Price is reasonable and  owner is professional. Offers quality Material. Kept me well informed throughout the process.. the  Family is loving the patio now.
